messages:
alex: Heads up — opened docs PR #4021 to add a 'minimal-install' profile for air-gapped private installs (edge sites). Need reviewers @priya @michael
priya: Quick skim — LGTM overall. Suggestion: add an nftables snippet for constrained NAT boxes (some customers only allow userland forwarding). I drafted one below.
priya: ```nft
table inet redwood_minimal {
  chain forward {
    type filter hook forward priority 0; policy accept;
    tcp dport {443, 22} counter accept
    ct state established,related accept
    counter drop
  }
}
```
michael: Nice. One concern: HSM/KMS customers may have a different pkcs11 path depending on vendor. We should include a clear note and examples for common vendors.
alex: Agree. I'll add an HSM note. @lina can you confirm the installer env var name for PKCS11? I think it's PKCS11_LIB_PATH.
lina: Confirmed — installer expects PKCS11_LIB_PATH. I'll add SoftHSM, Thales, and CloudHSM examples and a short paragraph about using kms-proxy when direct device access isn't possible (sealed/airgapped sites).
priya: For airgap installs also include the tarball import and checksum verify steps. Example command: `./installer --import-bundle /tmp/offline-bundle.tar.gz && sha256sum /tmp/offline-bundle.tar.gz`
docs-bot: Reminder: PR #4021 needs a changelog entry and a docs-tests link to the test harness (ci/docs-smoke-123).
sre-ops: Quick nit — the minimal profile shouldn't advertise tracing ports. We accidentally listed 9411 in the network matrix; that's Zipkin. Minimal should only list what installer needs: 443, 22, and the PKCS11 device node if present.
alex: Good catch. I'll remove tracing and add a sample systemd drop-in to bind the HSM device node into the installer container (useful on sealed sites):
alex: ```ini
[Service]
BindPaths=/dev/eph-pkcs11:/dev/pkcs11
Restart=on-failure
```
lina: Added. Also included a short troubleshooting section: "If PKCS11_LIB_PATH points to SoftHSM and you get permission denied, check udev rules and systemd BindPaths."
michael: Ready to approve after link fixes — current doc link https://internal/docs/private-install is 404. Update to /docs/private/vpc-install.md and re-run linkcheck.
priya: :thumbsup: I'll push a small commit to update links and add the nftables + HSM snippets.
alex: Thanks all — tagging @docs-bot to run smoke tests after the link fixes. Moving this to review.
